verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical, and both have the same flaws. The CTA is centred off the left text edge, and the three flavour pills are scattered unevenly: Blood Orange sits alone on the left, and the other two are stacked to the right with mismatched widths. The pills read as random fragments rather than one group, and the bottom third of the canvas is empty except for the clipped peach circle. B squeezes the subtitle and CTA slightly closer to the headline, which makes the copy cluster a bit more cramped, so A has marginally better breathing room.
